extracted.intended_audience: Duke investigators, unit grant managers, and pre-award research administrators preparing external funding proposals
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and checklist of common errors to avoid when preparing and routing external grant/contract proposals (NIH, NSF, DoD and other sponsors) for institutional approval and submission from Duke University.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final documents are not received
rubrics_metrics.description: Required final proposal documents are not delivered to the institutional office prior to submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the full submission-ready application and all final documents are delivered to ORA/ORS/Grants.Duke by internal deadlines so institutional review and approval can occur. Use Intent to Submit at least 15 business days in advance to alert support staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: The internal deadline was not met
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal routing did not meet the institution's internal deadline for review and approval.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comply with Duke internal deadlines (e.g., upload full submission-ready application at least five business days prior for Grants.Duke routing) so ORA/ORS can complete institutional clearance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal attestation is not completed
rubrics_metrics.description: Required institutional or investigator attestations (e.g., signatures/approvals) are missing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete any required attestations as part of routing and prior to submission to avoid preventable submission failures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed Principal Investigator is not eligible to serve as PI
rubrics_metrics.description: The named PI does not meet sponsor or institutional eligibility requirements to serve as PI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm sponsor and Duke PI eligibility requirements before developing the proposal. Resources: Duke PI Eligibility Guidance; NIH Eligibility pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: There is an irreconcilable issue from the required changes list
rubrics_metrics.description: Outstanding required institutional changes cannot be reconciled prior to submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resolve all items on the required changes list before routing for institutional approval. If irreconcilable, do not submit until resolved to avoid later rejection or withdrawal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application received with insufficient institutional review time (<2 days even with waiver)
rubrics_metrics.description: Application (even with approved waiver) arrives with less than two days for institutional review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid last-minute routing; obtain waivers only when necessary and still allow adequate time for ORA/ORS review per Duke policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Not following application guidelines (i.e., NOFO)
rubrics_metrics.description: Missing elements or key information, not following format or sponsor restrictions (budget limits, eligibility, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Read and follow the latest Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) or sponsor instructions carefully; sponsors may update guidelines after release. Resource examples: NIH Types of NOFOs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duke University is not eligible to submit as applicant organization
rubrics_metrics.description: The sponsor does not permit Duke to be the applicant organization for this FOA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check sponsor eligibility early (in application guidelines or sponsor website) to confirm both investigator and Duke institutional eligibility before developing the proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duke investigator is not eligible to serve as PI
rubrics_metrics.description: Investigator does not meet sponsor-specific PI eligibility requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Locate PI eligibility in sponsor guidance and verify both investigator and institution meet requirements prior to proposal development. See NIH and Duke PI eligibility resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duke faculty has a conflict (interest or commitment) that precludes serving as PI
rubrics_metrics.description: A conflict of interest or commitment prevents the faculty member from serving as PI (e.g., serving as Duke PI and subawardee PI simultaneously).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult Duke Office of Scientific Integrity-Conflict of Interest (DOSI-COI) to manage conflicts and obtain necessary approvals. Review COI best practices and training resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications not finalized/missing required elements in Grants.Duke necessary for ORA or ORS review
rubrics_metrics.description: Incomplete or non-submission-ready files in Grants.Duke prevent institutional review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Upload full submission-ready application in Grants.Duke at least five business days prior to submission. Follow Grants.Duke guidance and FAQs for electronic submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attaching items in SPS that are not required or should not be submitted (e.g., confidential information)
rubrics_metrics.description: Inappropriate documents or confidential data included in SPS where visible to others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only include necessary information for processing/tracking; do not include confidential material in SPS. Review SPS guidance for secure handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS Assignment Request Form used incorrectly or assignment request made in a cover letter
rubrics_metrics.description: Assignment preferences are not submitted in the correct form or are improperly placed in cover letters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the optional PHS Assignment Request Form when appropriate (to request IC/study section or exclusion of reviewers); do not use cover letter to request reviewer/study section assignments. See General Application Guide G.600.

rubrics_metrics.name: Including hyperlinked text in prohibited areas of the application
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of hyperlinks in application sections where sponsor forbids them (e.g., to circumvent page limits or compromise anonymity).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm sponsor policy on hyperlinks and avoid hyperlinks if not allowed; note that non-blue/underlined text may still be detected as hyperlinks. Resources: SF424 Guidance on Hyperlinks and URLs; NIH guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Circumventing page limitations by including research strategy elements in other areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Placing substantive research strategy material in sections without page limits (budget justification, letters of support, appendices) to bypass page limits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep all material required for review within the page limits of the appropriate section; sponsors may reject applications that inappropriately place material elsewhere. See NIH Guide to Format Attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resubmitting application before summary statement is released
rubrics_metrics.description: Submitting a resubmission application before the prior application's summary statement has been released when sponsor policy requires waiting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check sponsor policy (e.g., NIH resubmission rules) and confirm that the summary statement is released before resubmitting the same application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Not running an errors/warnings check before routing
rubrics_metrics.description: Failing to run system validations to catch sponsor/system errors prior to routing for institutional approval.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Run validations and errors/warnings checks (Grants.gov/agency systems) before routing to identify and correct submission issues early.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submitting documents to sponsors that require institutional review/approval without seeking review/approval in advance
rubrics_metrics.description: Submitting externally required documents (e.g., for human subjects, contracts) without institutional clearance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All applications must be reviewed and approved by a Duke institutional official in ORA or ORS prior to submission. Applications submitted without institutional clearance may not be accepted at award time.

rubrics_metrics.name: PDFs not flattened
rubrics_metrics.description: Submitting layered PDF files (fillable fields, signatures, text boxes, images) when sponsor requires flattened PDFs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flatten PDFs when required to merge layers; retain unflattened originals for audit. Check sponsor PDF requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Missing prime sponsor information if there is a pass-through entity awarding Duke
rubrics_metrics.description: Failure to identify the prime sponsor when Duke is being funded via a pass-through entity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If sponsor is not Federal and funds originate from a prime sponsor, enter the prime sponsor in the 'Prime Sponsor' field in SPS. See SPS guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Missing instructions from the pass-through entity when Duke will be subaward
rubrics_metrics.description: Not obtaining or uploading the pass-through entity's instructions that dictate what Duke must provide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collect all application instructions from the prime and upload them into the 'Proposal Memo' in SPS so ORA/ORS has the necessary information for review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lack of contextual information/background in SPS record
rubrics_metrics.description: SPS record missing helpful contextual documents (emails, notes) for unique or unusual proposal elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Upload relevant contextual information to 'Proposal Memo' in SPS (email threads, explanatory notes) to help ORA/ORS understand unique aspects of the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: International data points completed inaccurately
rubrics_metrics.description: Incorrect or incomplete completion of the 'Foreign Activities' section or international-related data in SPS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the Foreign Activities section fully and accurately; obtain details directly from the PI for accuracy. See myRESEARCHpath resources on international research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total budget exceeds maximum funds allowable by the sponsor
rubrics_metrics.description: The requested total budget exceeds the sponsor's stated funding limits for the FOA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check FOA/application instructions for maximum funding and constrain the budget accordingly. Some sponsors or programs limit funding per investigator.

rubrics_metrics.name: Using the incorrect base (MTDC or TDC) when calculating F&A
rubrics_metrics.description: Applying the wrong base (Modified Total Direct Costs vs Total Direct Costs) for calculating Facilities & Administration (F&A) charges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the correct base required by sponsor and Duke policy when calculating F&A; consult Duke F&A Rate Guidance and policy documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requesting an F&A waiver when not necessary or failing to request one when necessary
rubrics_metrics.description: Incorrect handling of F&A waiver requests relative to sponsor policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determine whether an F&A waiver is allowed/expected by the sponsor and follow Duke procedures for requesting waivers when necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manual adjustments to F&A in SPS without explanation
rubrics_metrics.description: Making unexplained manual changes to F&A entries in SPS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid unexplained manual F&A adjustments; document rationale and consult pre-award staff to ensure auditable treatment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application references cost share that has not been approved
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal mentions cost sharing commitments that lack prior institutional approval.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Duke policy: cost share only when required in writing by sponsor and approved in advance by designated management centers (ORA/ORS/SOM/SON). If approved, include commitments in SPS budget and follow procedures for recordation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rates or lump sums in other direct costs lack sufficient detail or substantiation
rubrics_metrics.description: Other direct cost line items (rates/lump sums) do not include adequate description, quotes, or substantiating documentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide sufficient detail and documentation for other direct costs, identify shared resources properly, and include quotes or substantiation as required by sponsor and auditors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Using patient care cost category incorrectly
rubrics_metrics.description: Misclassifying clinical-related costs into the wrong budget categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use correct budget categories for patient care, reimbursements, participant incentives vs stipends, and follow sponsor-specific instructions for clinical costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Using 'Patient Reimbursement' or 'Participant Stipend' when it should be 'Participant Incentives'
rubrics_metrics.description: Incorrect budget category selection for participant payments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the correct category for participant payments as defined by sponsor guidance to ensure proper allowability and accounting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Backing into a ceiling budget amount rather than budgeting on actual costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Setting the budget amount to match a ceiling rather than estimating realistic project costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Budget based on actual expected costs needed to complete the project work rather than simply meeting a ceiling figure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Costs not meeting Federal allowability/allocability/reasonableness/consistency criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Budget items lack documentation or do not meet criteria required under Uniform Guidance and sponsor rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure costs are adequately documented, necessary for performance, allowable, allocable, reasonable, consistently treated, conform to sponsor limits, not double-counted for cost sharing, and incurred during approved period. See Uniform Guidance Subpart E and Duke budget guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Blended budgets (cost-reimbursable and fixed price) used simultaneously on a single fund code
rubrics_metrics.description: Combining cost-reimbursable and fixed-price terms in one project fund code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid mixing cost-reimbursable and fixed-price terms in a single fund code; manage invoicing and contracting separately per award type. See Uniform Guidance §200.201 and Duke GAP references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employee vs. Independent Contractor designation incorrect or checklist not completed
rubrics_metrics.description: Incorrect classification of personnel as employees vs independent contractors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Duke Employee vs Independent Contractor Determination Matrix and complete the Independent Contractor Checklist before budgeting. Classification affects withholding, agreements, fringe, and F&A treatment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subrecipient vs. Vendor designation incorrect or checklist not completed
rubrics_metrics.description: Incorrectly classifying an external collaborator as a vendor rather than a subrecipient (or vice versa).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determine relationship based on type of work (not entity type), follow Uniform Guidance §200.331 characteristics, use Duke Subrecipient/Contractor Determination Checklist, retain decision documentation, and implement required monitoring processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum effort requirement not met
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal does not reflect sponsor-required minimum committed effort for PI or other personnel (e.g., NIH K, NCI minimums).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure budgeted effort is reasonable, measurable, and satisfies sponsor minimum requirements; for SOM a minimum of 1% PI effort at submission is expected. Adjust Total Professional Effort (TPE) and use Anticipated IBS/Appointment Change Request Form if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget justification lacking sufficient detail or breakdown
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative justification does not explain individual line items or provide calculation detail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a narrative description of each line item explaining why cost is necessary, organized in same order as budget, concise and readable (short paragraphs/headings), include only allowable costs, match figures to budget, and follow agency-specific length limits (e.g., NSF guidance). See Duke Sample Budget Justifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adding subawardee’s full budget justification into Duke’s budget justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Including a collaborating subaward organization's full detailed budget justification within Duke's own budget justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include only costs to be expended at Duke in Duke's budget justification; subawardee must provide its own justification as part of its subaward package to Duke.

rubrics_metrics.name: Including or failing to recognize voluntary cost sharing (in justification or elsewhere)
rubrics_metrics.description: Inadvertently committing to voluntary cost sharing or failing to document required cost sharing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow Duke policy: cost sharing only when required in writing by sponsor and approved in advance; document commitments at time of submission. Voluntary committed cost sharing for Federal research is not expected and cannot influence merit review.

rubrics_metrics.name: SOW not sufficiently detailed to know what work Duke is performing
rubrics_metrics.description: Statement of Work (SOW) is vague (e.g., 'Duke will perform Specific Aim 3') and does not delineate Duke-specific tasks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe in detail the work the Duke project team will perform so that performance and invoicing questions can be answered; develop the project idea page in myRESEARCHpath.

rubrics_metrics.name: SOW is an overall/combined SOW rather than Duke-specific
rubrics_metrics.description: SOW combines the work of multiple collaborators without isolating Duke's portion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a Duke-specific SOW that is not merged with collaborators' work. Ensure clarity on which institution performs which tasks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Referencing activities that require institutional approval without having approvals (e.g., F&A waiver, cost share, offsite facilities)
rubrics_metrics.description: SOW or budget references activities or costs that require prior institutional approval that has not been obtained.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obtain necessary institutional approvals in advance via ORA/ORS and unit grant administrators; complete Intent to Submit and engage research navigators if institutional review is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: SOW describes work that cannot be carried out by Duke
rubrics_metrics.description: The proposed SOW includes activities beyond Duke's capabilities or jurisdiction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify that all described activities can be performed by Duke; seek institutional guidance and approvals when required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch wrong format used
rubrics_metrics.description: Using an outdated or incorrect biosketch format for the sponsor (NIH/NSF differences).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep biosketches updated to the latest sponsor format and require collaborators to use the same. Use SciENcv or sponsor samples and instructions (NIH Biosketch, NSF-Approved formats).

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch missing appointments (including external appointments like VA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Failing to list current positions and scientific appointments, domestic or foreign, impacting Total Professional Effort reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List all current positions in reverse chronological order, including external appointments and affiliations per sponsor instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Referring to PDC appointment in biosketch
rubrics_metrics.description: Including references to the PDC (ended July 2023) on biosketches or elsewhere.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not reference the PDC; biosketch instructions require listing current positions only.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resources/Facilities section does not follow sponsor guidelines or is too long
rubrics_metrics.description: Facilities & Other Resources section contains excessive information, institutional history, or all unit resources rather than project-relevant resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the scientific environment and only include facilities and resources directly applicable to the proposed work; focus on how the environment contributes to success. Avoid URLs/hyperlinks unless allowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Describing facilities of another organization without evidence that organization is part of the project
rubrics_metrics.description: Including facilities of an external organization (e.g., Durham VA) without showing that the organization is part of the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include facilities of another organization only when there is evidence in the application that the organization is a performance site or collaborator.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protocol information incomplete for human subjects/animals
rubrics_metrics.description: Incomplete protocol or PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials information is provided where required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information form when human subjects or clinical trials are proposed; include sufficient protocol detail and avoid redundancies with research strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Not understanding what is considered human subjects research
rubrics_metrics.description: Misclassifying research activities that meet the regulatory definition of human subjects research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 45 CFR 46 definition and NIH decision tools to determine whether work involves human subjects. If in doubt, consult institutional compliance offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Not including PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information Form when required
rubrics_metrics.description: Failing to submit the PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information form when FOA/designation requires it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow FOA designation and instructions to determine when the form is required; include clear, specific description of study design, protections, monitoring, and population.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inconsistent data on human subjects across forms (e.g., SPS vs application forms)
rubrics_metrics.description: Discrepant answers or data indicating whether research involves human subjects across application components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure alignment across SPS, Grants.Duke fields, forms, and project descriptions so it is clear whether human subjects are involved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cover letter includes inappropriate information or fails to conform to sponsor instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Cover letters contain forbidden content (e.g., cost sharing), omit required info, make improper requests, or exceed page limits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow sponsor instructions for required/optional cover letter contents. For NIH, do not use cover letter to request awarding component/study section assignments (use PHS Assignment Request Form). Use cover letters only for allowed items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Support for consultants imply institutional resources without approval
rubrics_metrics.description: Letters for consultants employed by another institution imply use/commitment of that employer's resources without approval.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For consultants acting in an individual capacity, do not imply institutional resources (letterhead, facilities, data) without the organization's approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Not listing performance sites or misidentifying performance site activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Failing to include Duke as a performance site or omitting other locations where project work will occur.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List Duke as primary location and include any non-Duke performance sites where project work (especially human/animal work) will take place. Use G.230 Project/Performance Site Location(s) Form as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Not recognizing and justifying foreign components/collaborations described in abstract or research plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Failing to disclose or justify project activities that meet sponsor definitions of a foreign component.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify foreign components early, measure significance within the project context, and disclose via a Foreign Justification attached to the R&R Other Project Information Form. See NIH Definition of Foreign Component and myRESEARCHpath guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Not budgeting resources necessary to conduct international research
rubrics_metrics.description: Failing to include or understating costs unique to international research (travel, shipping, customs, local personnel, approvals).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review sponsor guidelines and work with unit grant manager and International Research Support Team to include necessary international costs and allow more time for preparation.

rubrics_metrics.name: RPPR (NIH) has not been routed to ORA
rubrics_metrics.description: The Research Performance Progress Report was not routed to ORA/S at the same time as the SPS record.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Route RPPRs to ORA/S concurrently with the SPS record to ensure institutional review; follow myRESEARCHpath RPPR guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effort for key personnel reduced by 25% or more without prior approval (NIH)
rubrics_metrics.description: Significant reductions in committed effort occurred without obtaining sponsor prior approval.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manage effort reductions during the budget period and request prior approval when required per NIH prior approval guidance and Grants Policy Statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foreign activity without prior sponsor approval reported on RPPR
rubrics_metrics.description: Foreign activity occurred without required prior approval and was not properly reported/approved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report foreign activity on the RPPR and obtain sponsor approval before work begins at the foreign site. See NIH prior approval guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Support missing or incomplete for key personnel named in the original proposal (NIH RPPR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Required Other Support documentation for key personnel is absent or incomplete in RPPR submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide completed Other Support for all key personnel named in the original application as required by NIH (except for specified exceptions like NIAID). Follow myRESEARCHpath Other Support guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effort in Other Support for next year does not align with SPS budget
rubrics_metrics.description: Discrepancy between effort reported in Other Support and the effort displayed in the SPS budget for the next year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure consistency between Other Support effort and SPS budget entries. Align reported effort to budgeted effort.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Support not signed and flattened in eRA Commons RPPR
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Support documents in RPPR are unsigned or not flattened in the eRA Commons upload.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sign and flatten Other Support PDFs before uploading in eRA Commons. NIH does not want Adobe certification in the uploaded file; store certification locally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overlap identified and no appropriate overlap management plan established
rubrics_metrics.description: Overlapping budget/funding or scientific overlap exists without an overlap mitigation/management plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Remedy overlap at JIT if possible; if overlap persists, consult pre-award office for the appropriate overlap management plan and reporting guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Insufficient justification for an unobligated balance of 25% or greater
rubrics_metrics.description: Large unobligated balance lacking a science-based, allowable justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Justify unobligated balances based on the science, describe intended allowable uses, and ensure justification conforms to award terms. See sample unobligated balance justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel (other than PI) reported with less than one calendar month effort when budgeted for 1 CM or more
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting fails to capture persons with one calendar month or more of effort as required in RPPR instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report effort for anyone with 1 CM or more in the budget period; follow NIH RPPR instructions for effort reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: ASSIST package for clinical research not submitted or not marked Ready for Submission
rubrics_metrics.description: ASSIST package for updating human subjects documents is not prepared or not marked as Ready for Submission prior to RPPR/proposal submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mark ASSIST packages as 'Ready for Submission' and include the ASSIST number in the proposal memo for submission to NIH when required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training plan referencing IDP not present for graduate students/postdocs in RPPR
rubrics_metrics.description: Failure to describe whether the organization has established Individual Development Plans (IDPs) for listed graduate students/postdocs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include training plan details and whether IDPs are in place for participants as part of RPPR Section D when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Major goals and aims changed without prior sponsor approval (RPPR question B.1.a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Significant changes to aims/goals occurred without obtaining prior approval when required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obtain prior approval for changes to Statement of Work; if B.1.a is answered 'yes' the appropriate approvals should have been secured previously.

rubrics_metrics.name: RPPR indicates a patent resulted but no patent information provided
rubrics_metrics.description: RPPR reports that patent activity occurred during the reporting period but fails to include patent details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the Office of Technology and Commercialization (OTC) and include required patent information on the RPPR.

rubrics_metrics.name: DMSP (Data Management and Sharing Plan) revisions must be reported if proposal submitted after 1/25/23
rubrics_metrics.description: Failing to report required DMSP revisions for proposals submitted after the specified date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow NIH RPPR instructions and myRESEARCHpath guidance on Data Management and Sharing policy to report DMSP revisions as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: FOA requires Excel spreadsheets which produce errors when submitting through Grants.Duke
rubrics_metrics.description: Some FOAs mandate Excel attachments that are incompatible with certain institutional submission pathways.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If FOA requires Excel, submit through the system specified by the FOA (e.g., Workspace in grants.gov) rather than using Grants.Duke if incompatible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attachments are not uploaded into the correct attachment number (DoD FOAs)
rubrics_metrics.description: DoD FOAs often specify numbered attachment slots; failing to place documents in required numbered slots causes transfer errors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow FOA attachment numbering exactly; if a document is not required, upload a blank document to maintain attachment order for eBRAP transfer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct cost cap excludes sub F&A (DoD) and has been misapplied
rubrics_metrics.description: Misunderstanding that DoD direct cost caps exclude subrecipient F&A, leading to budget noncompliance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow FOA-specific cost cap rules; for DoD, include sub F&A in direct costs when calculating cap as required by the FOA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Missing Small Business Subcontracting Plans for Duke and subawardees (DoD)
rubrics_metrics.description: Failure to prepare and include required Small Business Subcontracting Plans when thresholds are met.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Know dollar thresholds and start early to prepare subcontracting plans. Consult Supplier Diversity resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: F&A calculated at the wrong rate for DoD awards
rubrics_metrics.description: Applying incorrect F&A rate (e.g., using non-contracting DoD rate) leading to budget errors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the DoD contracting rate for F&A when required by the FOA and sponsor contracting terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorrect filenames used (DoD FOAs)
rubrics_metrics.description: FOA requires specified filenames for uploaded files and filenames do not match exactly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Match attachment filenames exactly to FOA requirements to avoid rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: SOM applications are not linked correctly in eBRAP
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications not linked to the SOM account, preventing ORA from viewing/submitting the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Link applications using gcmail@mc.duke.edu at LOI stage or have PI contact help desk to correct before ORA routing.

rubrics_metrics.name: eBRAP log number not entered into agency ID
rubrics_metrics.description: Failing to include assigned log numbers in the agency ID field when required (LOI stage assigned).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter assigned eBRAP/log numbers into the agency ID field as instructed by the FOA.

rubrics_metrics.name: SOM Other Support not routed for approval prior to application routing to ORA
rubrics_metrics.description: School of Medicine Other Support documents not routed early enough for approval.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Route SOM Other Support at least five business days before the SPS record routes to ORA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foreign component information not included in DoD budget justification
rubrics_metrics.description: DoD does not provide a separate foreign component attachment and requires foreign component info in the budget justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include foreign component details in the budget justification for DoD proposals per FOA instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: SOW timeline does not allow time for DoD review of human subjects/animal protocols
rubrics_metrics.description: SOW schedule fails to account for up to three months DoD review/approval time for human subjects/animal activity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Build sufficient time into the SOW timeline for DoD institutional and DoD review/approval of protocols (up to three months).

rubrics_metrics.name: Incomplete NSF Cover Page (fastlane/research.gov)
rubrics_metrics.description: Cover page omissions such as failure to check human subjects or international indicators when appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete cover page fields fully and accurately, including human subjects and international indicators where applicable. Follow PAPPG guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bio Sketch completed incorrectly for NSF
rubrics_metrics.description: NSF biosketch has incorrect number/detail of synergistic activities or duplicates (e.g., listing multiple editorial roles as separate entries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NSF allows 5 synergistic activities that should be unique; group related editorial/review activities as appropriate. Follow PAPPG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Late account setup for NSF (new faculty/subaward institutions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Failure to request/register and approve necessary accounts in time, delaying submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Set up accounts early and ensure Duke AOR approval; subcontracting institutions must also have accounts; use Research.gov or Fastlane as required by FOA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities & Other Resources (F&OR) not completed correctly for NSF
rubrics_metrics.description: Omitting key personnel without compensated effort from F&OR or failing to describe their effort appropriately.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include key personnel who have no compensated effort in F&OR and describe their contributions appropriately per PAPPG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current & Pending not completed correctly for NSF
rubrics_metrics.description: Not listing the current proposal as pending or mismatched titles between forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List the proposal being submitted as pending and ensure titles match across documents per PAPPG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Collaboration/Support not formatted correctly for NSF
rubrics_metrics.description: Using letters of support where letters of collaboration are required or using incorrect wording/placement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow FOA instructions for exact language and format; letters of support may be disallowed in supplementary documents unless specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Not following special requirements in the FOA (NSF)
rubrics_metrics.description: Missing FOA-specific requirements such as keywords in Project Summary or special section titles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Carefully read the FOA for special instructions and include required phrasing/structure (e.g., bolding intellectual merit/broader impacts in Project Summary if recommended).

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Summary incomplete (NSF)
rubrics_metrics.description: Project Summary missing intellectual merit or broader impacts statements or required formatting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include both intellectual merit and broader impacts statements in the one-page Project Summary and follow any recommended formatting (e.g., bolding headings).

rubrics_metrics.name: Title requirements not met (NSF)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal title does not meet FOA-specific prefix or formatting requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow FOA title requirements, including specified prefixes if required.

rubrics_metrics.name: No access for pre-award offices to the complete proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: Pre-award offices are not granted access to view the full proposal prior to routing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allow pre-award offices access to the complete proposal by the five-day deadline to enable institutional review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal entered into the wrong system (Fastlane vs Research.gov)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submitting the proposal through the incorrect NSF submission system when FOA specifies one.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow FOA/system instructions and submit via the system specified (Fastlane or Research.gov).

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Description not complete (NSF) — missing Prior NSF support statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Project Description lacking required elements such as prior NSF support statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a description of prior NSF support; if none, state that explicitly. Follow PAPPG instructions for Project Description content.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPS doesn’t match the proposal in Fastlane/Research.gov
rubrics_metrics.description: Budget values or other proposal elements in SPS differ from what was uploaded to NSF systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure budgets and figures loaded into agency systems match SPS (allowing minor rounding differences) prior to submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Insufficient budget justification (NSF)
rubrics_metrics.description: Budget justification does not adequately justify requested support (e.g., >2/9ths request for PI/Co-PI roles lacks rationale).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide sufficient justification for higher levels of requested support and follow NSF guidance on budget justification content.

rubrics_metrics.name: PI and Co-PIs with zero effort appear in Section A (NSF)
rubrics_metrics.description: Listing PI/Co-PIs with zero compensated effort in Section A implies prohibited cost sharing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delete zero-effort PI/Co-PI entries from Section A; instead describe their contributions in Facilities & Other Resources as appropriate without implying cost sharing.
